Assess the specification ./.scratch/config-admission-resilience/spec.md against the tickets, the canonical requirements/AC set, and the project development workflow. Decide whether implementation may start: are the requirements complete, unambiguous and non-contradictory; do ACs prove them; are the tasks and envelope sufficient and bounded; are secret-safety, compatibility and no-silent-fallback conditions explicit; does the design avoid inventing authority (especially T2 deploy and diagnosis-dependent paths)?
